cache_replacement: FIFO; a repeated key is not promoted
key: last four non-space bytes in current line, identical to CONTENT; short context INVALID
update: After arriving teacher, permitted records only: compare pre-feedback ERROR and Q_HALF correctness; increment stratum count/help/hurt; insert key after scoring
query_stratum: supported iff every presented option is in the past-write cache
selector: alpha=0.5 iff past stratum help > hurt; else alpha=1.0
support_only: alpha=0.5 on unsupported query, else1; diagnostic only
causal_control: N_old suppresses old native and authority writes together; observer-only-old is a separately named diagnostic
replay: Exploratory new observer learning on archived predictions; zero new native trajectories
